title: Arbeitsagentur Job Details Scraper
description: Fetch public Arbeitsagentur vacancy details by reference number, including role, employer, work schedule, pay, contract terms, and location. Batch job IDs for vacancy research.

data.stellenangebotsBeschreibung: Analyze operational data, build clear reporting, and collaborate with product and engineering teams.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Scrape Arbeitsagentur job details by reference number. Export role, employer, pay, contract terms, work schedule, and locations to compare vacancies.
storeCopy.intro: Retrieve public German Federal Employment Agency vacancy details by job reference number. Collect role descriptions, employer details, pay information, contract terms, and work locations.
useCases: Recruiters can review public vacancy requirements and employment conditions.
Labor-market analysts can compare salary and contract details across job listings.
Job platforms can enrich vacancy records with structured employer and location data.
howToUse: Add one Arbeitsagentur reference number to each entry in `job_refs`.
Set the result cap for the number of vacancy records to save.
Export the structured job details for your recruiting or labor-market workflow.

faqs.question: Where can I get a reference number?
faqs.answer: Use Arbeitsagentur Jobs Scraper to find active listings and copy each result reference number into this Actor.
